title: If I Were a Bird
text:
Every evening, Dao sat by her window and watched the birds fly over the rice fields. "If I (1) a bird," she often said, "I would fly to the city and see the tall buildings." Her grandmother always smiled. "If you (2) hard at school, you will see the city one day."
Dao did study hard. If she (3) a question, she asked her teacher until she understood. (4) the electricity went off, she read her books by candlelight. Years later, she won a scholarship to a university in Bangkok. On her first night in the city, she looked out of her dormitory window. "If Grandma (5) here now, she would be so proud," she thought.
She called home. "If I had not listened to you," she told her grandmother, "I (6) here today." Her grandmother laughed. "(7) you keep working hard, you will go even further." Dao promised that she (8) home every holiday. "And (9) you see a bird over the fields," she said, "think of me." Her grandmother said she would wait for her (10) the bus station.

items.explanation_th: สมมุติไม่จริง + would → were
why_wrong: am ไม่ใช้กับ would
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
had been ใช้กับอดีต

items.stem: (2) "If you ___ hard at school, you will see the city one day."
items.explanation_th: แบบที่ 1 (will see) → If you study
why_wrong: หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
studied ใช้กับ would
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ would

items.stem: (3) If she ___ a question, she asked her teacher until she understood.
items.explanation_th: นิสัยในอดีต (asked) → If she didn't understand
why_wrong: doesn't เป็นปัจจุบัน ขัดกับ asked
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ would

items.stem: (4) ___ the electricity went off, she read her books by candlelight.
items.explanation_th: ทุกครั้งที่ไฟดับ → Whenever
why_wrong: Whatever = อะไรก็ตาม
However = แค่ไหนก็ตาม
Wherever = ที่ไหนก็ตาม

items.stem: (5) "If Grandma ___ here now, she would be so proud,"
items.explanation_th: สมมุติไม่จริงตอนนี้ + would → were
why_wrong: is ไม่ใช้กับ would
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
had been ใช้กับอดีต

items.stem: (6) she told her grandmother, "I ___ here today."
items.explanation_th: If อดีต (had not listened) → ผลถึงปัจจุบัน (today) → wouldn't be
why_wrong: won't be ใช้กับแบบที่ 1
am not ไม่ใช่ประโยคหลักของเงื่อนไข
wasn't ไม่ใช่ประโยคหลักของเงื่อนไข

items.stem: (7) "___ you keep working hard, you will go even further."
items.explanation_th: ตราบใดที่ยังขยัน → As long as
why_wrong: As far as ความหมายผิด
As well as ความหมายผิด
As soon as = ทันทีที่ ความหมายไม่เข้า

items.stem: (8) Dao promised that she ___ home every holiday.
items.explanation_th: เล่าคำสัญญาในอดีต (promised that) → would come
why_wrong: will ต้องถอยเป็น would
comes ไม่ถอย tense
coming ไม่ใช่กริยาแท้

items.stem: (9) "And ___ you see a bird over the fields,"
items.explanation_th: ทุกครั้งที่เห็นนก → whenever
why_wrong: whatever = อะไรก็ตาม
however = แค่ไหนก็ตาม
whether ต้องมี or และไม่บอกเวลา

items.stem: (10) Her grandmother said she would wait for her ___ the bus station.
items.explanation_th: จุดสถานที่ (สถานี) → at the bus station
why_wrong: on ไม่ใช้กับสถานี
wait for her for the bus station ผิด
of ไม่มีความหมายตรงนี้
